messages:
morgan: Kicking off canary for release v3.4.1 now — changewindow start.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (3/5 hosts). Tracking metrics at https://go.internal/metrics/rollouts/4467890123

sara: FYI seeing 5xx starting around +70s, ~1.8% but trending up. looks like retry spikes on the reranker.

nathan: Can you paste the exact model variant we pinned for this canary?

morgan: Pinned model: redwood/gpt-neo-small-quant-v2 @rev-20260310. Release notes: https://go.internal/releases/v3.4.1

sara: Checking logs — tokenization OOMs in worker-7. stack traces pointing to kv cache eviction path.

rupert_oncall: If canary 5xx > 2% for 3 mins we should initiate backout. Follow backout runbook: <https://go/runbooks/backout-deploy-v2|backout-deploy-v2 runbook>. Step snippet below for quick reference:
```
# minimal backout to revert canary
1) /deploy abort --thread 4467890123 --reason "canary 5xx > threshold"
2) /deploy pin --service inference --version v3.4.0
3) kvcache-cli purge --prefix=canary/3.4.1
4) monitor infra and traffic for 10m
```

sara: Starting KV cache purge on canary nodes now (kvcache-cli purge --prefix=canary/3.4.1). Will ping when complete.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: kvcache purge started by sara (job id 8843). See https://go.internal/jobs/8843

morgan: If purge doesn't drop errors within 5m, we'll abort the canary and pin v3.4.0. lina-pm heads-up: possible brief latency blip during rollback.

lina-pm: Acknowledged. Keep comms short — will notify support if we abort.

sara: Purge finished. Errors dropped to 0.7% over the last 90s.

rupert_oncall: Good — keep monitoring. If it stays <1% we continue canary. If it creeps above 2% again, execute the abort steps and follow runbook trace-id workflow.

nathan: Can we add a short-term throttle to reranker to reduce concurrency while canary runs? simple config toggle:
```
service.inference.reranker.max_concurrency=8
```

morgan: Doing toggled to 8 on canary hosts.

deploy-bot: Config update applied to canary hosts by morgan. Config job id 9921.

sara: Metrics stabilized. 5xx steady at 0.5% for 6m. keeping watch.

morgan: Closing thread — continuing canary to full rollout if no regressions in change window. Runbook link again: <https://go/runbooks/backout-deploy-v2|backout runbook>. :white_check_mark:
